visual_concept: 一张深墨蓝书桌上，左边是一个被揉皱撕开的厚卷轴（写着密密麻麻的2000字prompt），右边是一张简洁折叠的便签（写着200字prompt），中间散落着齿轮和连接线（工程化元素），桌面有暖米白手绘纹理，一个金色纸飞机从卷轴飞向便签，暗示重心转移。
image_prompt:
A FLAT EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION in classic editorial magazine cover art style. Ink and watercolor on textured dark paper, designed-not-rendered, with visible hand-drawn linework and intentional limited color palette.

This is NOT a photograph, NOT a 3D render, NOT a cinematic concept-art image. Think the look of a printed editorial illustration on dark paper.

SUBJECT:
A deep ink-dark desk surface (the background). On the left side: a crumpled and torn scroll of paper densely covered with tiny Chinese handwriting (representing the 2000-character verbose prompt), partly ripped open, edges curling. On the right side: a small clean folded note with sparse concise Chinese text (the 200-character optimized prompt). Between them, scattered metallic cogwheels and thin connecting wires (engineering components) form a bridge. A small golden paper airplane flies from the left scroll toward the right note, symbolizing the shift of focus. The entire scene is seen from a slight overhead angle, as if the viewer is looking down at a worktable. No real logos or trademarks.

STYLE (critical — must enforce):
- FLAT ILLUSTRATION, ink and watercolor style
- visible brush strokes, paper texture, hand-drawn linework
- matte finish, designed-not-rendered
- limited color palette with intentional negative space (dark)
- NO photorealism, NO CGI, NO cinematic rendering
- NO glossy plastic, NO chrome, NO 3D realism
- NO photographic depth-of-field, NO bokeh

LIGHTING & MOOD:
- Soft warm glow from the golden paper airplane, illuminating the desk in a small radius
- Otherwise dim, with deep shadows; mood is quiet, focused, and reflective
- NOT cinematic lighting, NOT realistic shadows

COMPOSITION (the one principle: CANVAS UNITY):
- 2.35:1 horizontal aspect ratio = 47:20 (1920×816 default)
- The entire canvas is one designed object: the desk surface forms the continuous ground, the scroll and note and gears all belong to the same workspace. The title text is embedded into the upper right area, visually connected to the note by a thin golden line. The paper airplane traces an arc across the middle. No element floats in isolation; the negative space on the left is intentional breathing room for the crumpled scroll. The bottom-left corner contains a few gear wheels that lead the eye toward the center. The right side has the note and a small pile of engineering blueprints folded under it. The whole composition reads as a single frame of a workshop moment.

COLOR PALETTE (strict, with area proportions):
- Dominant background (deep ink blue #1B2230): 65% of canvas (the desk surface and shadow areas)
- Signature foreground (warm beige white #F0E7D6): 20% (scroll, note, gears, blueprint edges)
- Secondary support (stone grey #6E7E90): 10% (gear shadows, wire lines, subtle texture)
- Emphasis (warm gold #E3B341): 4% (the paper airplane, one accent point on the note, and the connecting line)
- Ignition accent (vermilion #D14A3A): 1% (a single small gear tooth near the center that catches a glint)
- NO pure black (#000000), NO pure white (#FFFFFF), NO rainbow gradients, NO neon

TEXT IN IMAGE:
- main title: "80%工程 20%prompt" — Chinese, in Song typeface (serif), warm beige white #F0E7D6, large and dominant, placed in the upper-right quadrant, angled slightly to follow the airplane's trajectory. The title is outlined with a thin gold line that connects to the note.
- No subtitle text. The bottom-left and top-right corners intentionally left as clean dark negative space.

NEGATIVE:
- NO abstract neural network diagrams
- NO glowing brain or digital head
- NO robot-human handshake
- NO circuit board background
- NO data stream / particle flows
- NO gradient geometric shapes
- NO VR goggles, NO AR headsets
- NO holographic UI floating in air
- NO futuristic city skyline
- NO chrome/metallic AI face
- NO binary code rain
- NO glossy plastic finish
- NO real-world brand logos or trademarks
- NO photographic realism, NO cinematic concept art
